dataList.content:
<Hmm... Yeah, what should we do?>
<嗯……该怎么办呢。>
Your choice, self-appointed class president. 你决定就好。反正都一样。

Heathcliff replied nonchalantly.
希斯克利夫几乎是在说“怎样都行”。

Well, alright...
嗯，那么……

Let's head right in, then.
进去看看吧。

dataList.content:
Y-yeah, smooth moves, Ishy. Let's just pretend none of that happened, turn around, and keep walking.
没、没错~是正常的呢，以实。咱们就当作无事发生，右转回去吧。

What happened?!
发生什么事了！
I-I don't—I just didn't expect that, you know...? 不、不对……我可没想过会变成这样……

<So... does that mean that we can move on like nothing happened? Or is it a case of no-backsies—>
<话说回来，如果再次把门关上，就能当作无事发生吗？>

That's when the host's voice, after a long silence, suddenly began buzzing again.
就在那时，安静了一会儿的主持人的声音再度传来。

My, oh my... a certain candidate and his clan elected to bravely open a mysterious door... only to immediately slam it shut in fear! Right, so... I won't name names, on account of it being a rather embarrassing display of spinelessness, but hey. I'll give you guys a chance to rectify that!
哎呀……某位候选人与其势力打开了神秘的门……却立刻将它关上了！因为太丢人我就隐去姓名了……不过会给你们一次重新考虑的机会！

Heeugh! M-Manager Esquire! We must open the door once again, posthaste! An agile craven we shall be made, should we not act swiftly!
呼啊啊！经理老爷！此刻并非做这种事的时候！这般下去吾等皆会被认定为狡猾的胆小鬼的！

Don Quixote ran up to the door and began bouncing up and down with genuine panic.
堂吉诃德心中焦急难耐，在门前咚咚跺脚。

<We did see something pretty ugly-looking in there, but...>
<虽然我们似乎在里面看到了一些可怕的东西……>

<It wasn't an Abnormality or a Distortion. I didn't feel anything like it around here, either.>
<但那既不是异想体也不是扭曲。周围并没有那种感觉。>

I dunno, that almost makes it worse...
这话不是让人更不想开门了吗……？

... It might seem like the host is there just to make some goofy commentary on us, but everything she's said so far has had at least one grain of truth to it.
……哪怕主持人看上去只会嘲讽我们，她的话里也总是藏着很多信息。

Sigh... let's check out what's inside. We won't know what's waiting for us in there unless we actually face it.
呼……进去看看吧。那个是什么，又为什么会出现在这里……不直接面对是不会明白的。

Ishmael, now motivated to make up for her earlier blunder, confidently opened the door.
或许是要挽回刚刚失败的决心给了以实玛利力量，她勇敢地再度打开了门。

The same type of coin we received at the beginning of the game is hanging from the entity's neck.
他的脖子上挂着与我们所收到的物品形状一致的铜钱。

Another demonstration of Meursault's impeccable observation skills.
默尔索准确的观察力再度大放异彩。

H-huh, you're right! Why is it wearing a coin...?
真、真的吗？为什么脖子上会有铜……

Well, given the circumstances, we can probably gain that coin by kicking this monster to the curb, right?
那么看这情况……打倒那个怪物就能得到那些铜钱吧？

dataList.content:
We... desire only to repent... An eternal repentance... We desire only to repent... An eternal repentance...
只是……想要忏悔……永远忏悔下去……只是想要忏悔……永远忏悔下去……

The thing endlessly repeats an unknowable mantra.
那个身份不明的东西不断低语着意义不明的话语。

It sounded at once desperate and hopeless.
像是在渴求着什么，又仿佛是放弃了一切。

They're certainly not abnormal beings.
他们确实不是异形的存在呢。

...? Yeah, that's what Dante just said.
……？没错，不就和但丁经理刚刚说的一样吗。

Hong Lu began as though he recognized them.
鸿璐像是知道那些东西的身份一般，开口说道。

They're... people.
那些……是人类。

Hongyuan's condemned.
鸿园的囚犯们。
